_comment: Model of record per competition group, chosen on validation and confirmed once on test (DECISIONS.md D-025, D-026). Each group is a list of periods, oldest first. A fixture takes the latest period whose from_utc is at or before its kickoff (00:00 UK on its date if the kickoff is unknown); within it, the record of record is the first listed model with a genuine pre-match record for the fixture. from_utc null = from the start. Only ever append a period, from now or later: uv run footy set-model-of-record --group domestic --models a,b --from now. Other models' saved predictions stay visible but are not the headline record.

domestic.note: D-026: model + market selected on validation (0.9449) and tested once (0.9555 vs dixon_coles 0.9693); dixon_coles for fixtures without prices
D-026: pure fallback congestion_context_on_elo (validation 0.9517, test 0.9661 vs dixon_coles 0.9693); dixon_coles last, for fixtures without a newer record

uefa.note: D-026: market-trained ratings; test composite 0.9666 against 0.9686
